title: The Secret Locker
author: P. M. Yarrow
blurb: Tamsin Sandoval, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
